quote: I am an environment artist creating high and low poly assets for several projects including the game Wayward Realms. After fighting several other apps and spending too much money SculptForge fits like a hand-made glove. While there is much to love about this software I am glad I found something that actually makes sense.
name: Richard Throgmorton (MakIt3D)

quote: You add it so quick !!? On Saturday !? Wow !
name: GABO - Gabriel Abdala

quote: After years of struggling with expensive software subscriptions, finding SculptForge felt like a breath of fresh air. What inspires me most is seeing how actively it is evolving, with new improvements and features arriving regularly. I genuinely believe this application has a bright future. As a Senior Lead Character & Creature Artist in the video game industry and a mentor, my advice to artists is simple: don't chase millions of polygons. Plan your models, build your forms intelligently, and add detail when needed. Good planning is always more important than raw polygon counts.
name: Abhik Mitra (VOIDART ACADEMY)
